title: Brisk walk 30 minutes
steps: Warm up with 5 minutes of easy walking.
Pick up the pace until your breathing is deeper but you can still speak a short sentence.
Hold that pace for 20 minutes, easing off if you cannot talk at all.
Slow to an easy walk for the last 5 minutes, then stand still and breathe.
mistakes: Letting your arms hang still instead of swinging them.
Leaning forward from the waist rather than walking tall.
